---
# Copy to src/content/prompts/<slug>.md. URL: /prompts/<slug>/
# Use a descriptive slug people search for, e.g. chatgpt-cover-letter-prompt.

title: 'Cover Letter Prompt: ...'
# seoTitle: 'Shorter title if "title | Jajati AI" is over 70 characters (max 58)'
description: 'What it does, for whom. Shown in search results and cards. Max 160 characters.'

# One of: prompt-engineering, resume-career, interview-prep, education, productivity, business-marketing,
#         content-creation, fact-checking, image-generation, video-generation, coding
category: resume-career
# Any of: chatgpt, gemini, claude, any-chat-ai, notebooklm, nano-banana
tools: [chatgpt]
# Beginner | Intermediate | Advanced
difficulty: Beginner

# The exact prompt. Put things the visitor must change in [square brackets]: they are highlighted.
prompt: 'Tum ek ... ho. Mujhe [ye chahiye] ...'
# promptLang: hi-Latn   # default. Use en for English-only prompts.

problem: 'The problem this prompt solves, in one sentence.'
placeholders:
  - token: '[ye chahiye]'
    meaning: 'What to write here.'

# Optional. Only a real, filled-in version. Label samples as samples.
# exampleInput:
#   text: 'Tum ek ... ho. Mujhe ...'
#   note: 'Sample filled-in version.'
# Optional. Only an output you actually got and saved. Never write one from imagination.
# exampleOutput: '...'

source:
  label: 'Where this prompt comes from, e.g. "AI Explained Episode 6 script"'
  # note: 'Anything to know about the source.'

added: 2026-11-07
featured: false   # true shows it in "Popular" on the homepage, /start/ and /prompts/
order: 100        # lower comes first among featured prompts

# Optional references, by file name without .md
# resource: chatgpt-prompt-cheatsheet
relatedEpisodes: []
relatedPrompts: []
# video:
#   youtube: 'https://www.youtube.com/shorts/...'
#   instagram: 'https://www.instagram.com/reel/.../'
---

## Kab use karein

When this prompt helps.

## Kaise use karein

1. Prompt copy karo.
2. `[brackets]` mein apni details likho.
3. Answer check karo.
